topic: Mithu the Parrot Learns New Colors
description: Join Mithu the parrot and Chintu the elephant on a colorful adventure to learn new colors. This fun video helps toddlers identify vibrant colors with magical surprises!
learning: Teaching toddlers to identify colors Red, Blue, and Yellow through interactive play.

scenes.text: Arrey! Magic box mein kya chupa hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up 3D render of a colorful glowing magic box on a playground, Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot looking curious, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: Chalo dekhte hain! One, two, three!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the green parrot with a red cap flapping wings excitedly, Chintu the orange elephant tapping his trunk on the magic box, bright 3D garden background.

scenes.text: Wow! Ye toh hai RED colour!
scenes.image_prompt: The magic box opens to reveal a shiny red apple, Mithu and Chintu looking surprised with sparkles around them.
Mithu and Chintu jumping around a floating blue balloon, vibrant blue sky background, cute 3D animation style.

scenes.text: Twist and turn, Yellow is fun!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu and Chintu dancing with a yellow sunflower, cheerful expressions, high quality 3D render.

scenes.text: Clap your hands for all these colors!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu and Chintu clapping their hands together, a rainbow arching in the background, very happy mood.
Close-up of Mithu and Chintu laughing together, bright and colorful scene, cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic box mein phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu pointing his wing back toward the closed magic box, Chintu looking directly at the camera, loop-ready composition.
